edges.relationship: 300mm silicon wafers supplied to SK Hynix fabs (related party under SK Inc.)

contracts.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), related-party transactions (consolidated): purchases from SK Siltron of KRW 244,669M in H1 2026 (Q2 alone KRW 122,583M), up from KRW 249,621M in H1 2025 on a cumulative basis (Q2 2025 KRW 127,013M); payables to SK Siltron KRW 80,350M at 2026-06-30. Wafers were 9% (KRW 999,418M) of SK Hynix H1 raw-material inputs; the filing says 300mm finished wafers come from major suppliers with fabs in Japan, Korea, Germany and the US under mid-to-long-term relationships.
contracts.value: KRW 244,669M purchases H1 2026; payables KRW 80,350M at 2026-06-30

edges.relationship: back-end package/test/module services for SK Hynix Wuxi DRAM under a JV service contract

contracts.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026): SK Hynix buys back-end services (package, package test, module) from HITECH Semiconductor (Wuxi) Co., Ltd., a 45%-owned joint venture, under a contract that gives SK Hynix priority rights to HITECH equipment in return for a guaranteed minimum revenue payment. Consolidated purchases from HITECH KRW 418,903M in H1 2026 (Q2 KRW 202,241M) vs KRW 371,769M in H1 2025; asset acquisitions from HITECH KRW 9,102M H1 2026; payables to HITECH KRW 376,743M at 2026-06-30; HITECH paid SK Hynix dividends of KRW 20,533M in H1 2026. HITECH H1 2026 revenue KRW 413,517M, net profit KRW 19,642M; carrying value KRW 150,347M.
contracts.units: H1 2026 (01-01-2026 to 06-30-2026); package, package test and module services
contracts.value: KRW 418,903M purchases H1 2026; payables KRW 376,743M at 2026-06-30
